item.description: ALBAWABA - Vlogger Vitaly Zdorovetskiy, best known for his controversial pranks on YouTube, recently took to social media to share his experience during his 290-day detention in the Philippines. item.title: Israeli drone strike kills Lebanese civilian in southern Lebanon
item.description: ALBAWABA- A Lebanese civilian was killed in an Israeli drone strike targeting a vehicle in the Zahrani district, south of Sidon, local authorities and witnesses reported early Wednesday. The car caught fire instantly, resulting in the civilian’s death, while his identity has not yet been released. item.title: Japan restarts world’s largest nuclear plant
item.description: ALBAWABA- Japan restarted operations at the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant, the world’s largest by capacity, nearly 15 years after the Fukushima disaster triggered a nationwide reactor shutdown. Operated by Tokyo Electric Power Company (TEPCO) in Niigata Prefecture, the No. 6 reactor resumed partial operations following a minor alarm glitch during final tests.
